name: Terrain Painter
description: Terrain tools in the terrain editor: raise, lower, plateau, smooth, ground textures, cliffs, water, blight and ramps. Edit Tileset / Terrain Settings: the tileset, the map's ground tiles and cliff types (order, adding, removing) and the terrain's facts, in a tab of their own.

terrain.brush.strength.description: How strong a height brush stamp is, in percent of the World Editor's (100).
